system.description:
You are an indomitable and unstoppable force.

Powers/Qualities

Assign one or more of the dice you rolled at the end of the power source step to any of these powers:

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.hQIArnjTuOBxYoPT]{Signature Vehicle}

• @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.powers.Item.fubw8CJu2mXFZJUD]{Signature Weaponry}

• Select from Athletic powers category

• Select from Intellectual powers category

• Select from Materials powers category

• Select from Mobility powers category

• Select from Technological powers category

Assign any remaining dice to any of these qualities:

• Select from Physical qualities category

• Select from Social qualities category

Abilities

Gain the following Green ability:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.0SIacYiyqsFTPovE]{Armored}

Gain three of these Green abilities of your choice, using at least two different powers:

  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.cyHxS1GUExiDEJZV]{Deflect}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.6BYMFdvoejvDBh9P]{Dual Offense}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.vWAHWQ5SsWBfi7vC]{Living Bulwark}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.uPFnUKUH60kAZEHd]{Repair}
  • @UUID[Compendium.scrpg-actor-compendium.abilities.Item.HgvvG5jACSFcG5UI]{Unstoppable Charge}

Principle

Choose an Expertise principle.

When determining Health during step 7, you may use a Materials or Technological power instead of an Athletic power or Mental quality.

Roll for personality selection.
